edits.label: MainZone-Other
edits.why: line 24 is the text's title line (Chukchi title and «О бѣлой медвѣдицѣ сказка»), short and centred in the column, a heading and so MainZone-Other; it sits after the heading «117.» and is not continuing body text, so Continued contradicts it.

notes.text: Indented colophon «Записано отъ чукчи ... въ Нижнеколымскѣ», band 3 MainZone-P; left as is.
Heading «117.» in band 4 MainZone-Other is right; bands 4 and 5 are both headings of the new text and could be one band, but separate Other bands hold every line they should.
